test_disable_progress_bars: test that disable_progress_bars globally disables tqdm output in the datasets library
test_enable_progress_bars: test that enable_progress_bars globally enables tqdm output in the datasets library
test_are_progress_bars_disabled: test the are_progress_bars_disabled function to check current progress bar state
test_tqdm_with_env_override: test that HF_DATASETS_DISABLE_PROGRESS_BARS env variable prevents enabling or disabling progress bars
test_tqdm_local_disable: test that tqdm can be locally disabled with disable=True even when globally enabled
